title: QuickBrush
description: The mod allows you to instantly place custom block volumes and features full fluid support (water and lava) directly through the GUI. Customize your brush length, width, and click distance to eliminate the routine of placing blocks one by one!
body:
QuickBrush is a versatile Minecraft construction utility designed for rapid area filling and world "painting" with blocks.

Key Feature: The mod works flawlessly OUTSIDE of Creative Mode! This makes it the ultimate tool for YouTubers, streamers, and content creators. Run insane custom challenges, execute massive world-painting races, or set up unique showmatches for your videos.

The mod allows you to instantly place custom block volumes and features full fluid support (water and lava) directly through a clean GUI. Configure your brush length, width, and click distance to fit any challenge, and take your building events to the next level!
